llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward Chinese official-document formatter that creates a local Word document as its expected output.

dimensions.detail: The script reads only user-supplied text or a user-specified input file and writes a .docx output, which is proportionate for a formatter, but users should be aware it creates files locally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, remote payload retrieval, tool replacement, or dependency installation command is present; the script references python-docx as its core library.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions stay within document writing and formatting behavior; the Chinese language and locale-specific formatting are clearly part of the skill's described purpose rather than hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to generated .docx files in a disclosed default Desktop folder or a user-provided output path; there is no evidence of background services, hooks, scheduled tasks, memory writes, or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, instructions, and script all align around formatting Chinese official documents, research reports, and general articles into .docx files using fixed Chinese document conventions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want Chinese official-document-style Word formatting. Be aware that it can create a .docx file under ~/Desktop/openclaw专属文件夹 by default, so use the -o option for sensitive documents or shared machines.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The locale-specific Chinese official-document framing in SKILL.md is expected because the skill explicitly presents itself as a Chinese government-style document formatter.
[SQP-2] expected: The default Desktop output path is disclosed in SKILL.md and implemented in the script; local file creation is expected for a .docx formatter, though users should choose a path carefully for sensitive content.
[SQP-3] expected: The script's hard-coded Chinese fonts, page margins, and document-type rules are consistent with the stated Chinese official-document formatting purpose.
